name: poc-studio
description: POC Studio: runs a UnifyApps POC end to end in four phases, each closed by an owner gate sent to Slack and shown in the chat: signals and web research (G1 Path), scope, BRD, design system and mockups (G2 Scope and BRD), a code-first build with the code-builder Nebula plus rehearsal and checks (G3 Final review), and collaterals (G4 Release). Every document, decision and feedback ticket is saved to Orbit and read back before any human step. Includes /poc-studio:setup to connect Slack, Calendar, Drive and Orbit once, the verified UnifyApps platform skills, the design-system and research skills, and the demo video skill. Based on Demo Studio 0.6.0 by Gourav Mahunta. Requires the Nebula plugin.
